1) **Yes.** There is a "report preview" card visible on the right side of the hero section. It is titled **"PRELIMINARY SITE INTELLIGENCE BRIEF"** with the subtitle **"Site Screen · Illustrative sample"** and a **"DEMO DATA"** badge. It contains a map placeholder, a list of findings (zoning, interconnection queue, permitting status, adjacent activity), and a footer with evidence counts and an "Open full brief" link.

2) **NO stacked depth cards.** The report preview card is a single, flat element with a subtle drop shadow. There are no offset cards behind it or around it creating a layered/stacked depth effect.

3) Yes, the phrase **"a deeper look"** is underlined. The underline is a **clean, straight line** (solid green).

4) The hero is **clean and spacious**. It uses a clear two-column layout with ample white space (padding/margins). There is no visible overflow, clipping, or weird gutters; the alignment is precise and professional.
